rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for the skin or outer layer of a fruit or vegetable.

example.english: This apple's peel is very thin, so you don't need to peel it.
example.traditional: 呢個蘋果嘅皮好薄，唔使削。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 gwo2 ge3 pei4 hou2 bok6 m4 sai2 soek3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for removing the skin or outer layer of fruit and similar objects.

example.english: I'll peel an orange for you first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 bok1 go3 caang2 sin1

rows.note: Use this when skin or a surface layer is coming off in flakes or strips, especially after sunburn.

example.english: After getting sunburned, my arm is starting to peel.
example.traditional: 曬完太陽，我隻手臂甩緊皮。
example.jyutping: saai3 jyun4 taai3 joeng4 ngo5 zek3 sau2 bei3 lat1 gan2 pei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for taking off clothes, rather than removing a physical outer layer.

example.english: I peel off my shirt as soon as I get home and take a shower.
example.traditional: 我返到屋企就即刻除衫沖涼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 zik1 hak1 ceoi4 saam1 cung1 loeng4
